text_block_list.text: I finally did it! A new record time for meee!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We're three days into our summer camp.
Every day, El and I train for
hours under
the hot rays of the sun.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate an Umamusume from
the scorching sands!
Burning heat, searing
winds—blazin' sands! I've conquered them
all!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All right, now to run from one side of the
beach to the other!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
El's progress since coming to this summer
camp has been
extraordinary, to say the
least. I have to make sure I match her

enthusiasm—
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Trainer, are you even listenin'?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! This again?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I bet you're just thinkin' about training
again, aren'tcha? You totally
zoned out
when I talked about the festival yesterday,
too...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You've been all work-only mode this
camp, ignorin' me left and right!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, you're almost at three strikes! Next
time you ignore me, I'll
become a storm of
anger, a raging wind—an erupting volcano!
So be
careful, okay?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Then we're good! Anyways, like I was
saying...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I'm done preparin' for tonight's "El's
Hotter-than-the-Sun Infernal
Training from
Beyond!" Make sure you wear something
easy to move
in!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Yup, it's a super intensive two-person
training session just for you and
me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I've made preparations so that you can
train along with me! I even got
a tire just
for you!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
...Wait, you aren't gonna say you forgot
about this plan, are you?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I know you're not the type of person to say, "Did I agree to that," or, "I never heard about this," right before we do something, riiight?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Man, I'm gettin' hyped for tonight!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Oh, and since we're the dynamic duo, it's
natural for us to at least
sync up our
breathing.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
First, we'll run the beach and swim the
ocean... then we'll climb the
hills and slide
down through the forest...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we're gonna do some hardcore
training fit for a summer camp! I
won't go
easy on either of us!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Looks like I have no choice but to go
along with El's plan.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her wings glimmer in the dead of night!
Blessed by the heavens, it's
none other
than El Condor Pasaaaaa!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
C'mon, it's time for our infernal training!
Trainer, can I get your
thoughts before the
match?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Wow! Looks like you're pumped! I'm
excited to see how far that spirit
of yours
takes you tonight!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: And here we aaaaare!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Si! It's a bright and fun summer festival!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Here, we'll do some training to help you
replenish both your body
and mind!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Recently, all you do is work, work, and
work some more. Whether
we're on break
or in the middle of meal time—you never
stop looking
at your papers!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You sleep late, but get up early! I bet
you're totally sleep-deprived,
aren't you?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
So today, feel free to just enjoy yourself
and have fun!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Mhm, I smell something spicy over there!
It's tacos, no doubt about it!
Hurry,
quickly—let's sprint! I'll go buy us some!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
We don't have even a second to waste!
We're gonna enjoy this
festival as much, as
fully, and as awesomely as we possibly
can!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса grabs me by the hand and
takes me around several
food stalls...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... Ah, Twainer. Wanna twy golish soopin neth?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list: Finish eating before you talk, okay?

text_block_list.text: Gulp... Haha, now that's the Trainer I know.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Keep the good vibes going! Just go with
the flow and have some fun!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Act natural, don't think too hard—just be
yourself! Otherwise, the
future me will be
in a pinch.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Yup. Listen up, okay? As you know, I will
one day carve my name in
the annals of
history.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And just like my pro-wrestler papa, I'll win
a bunch of races! I can
already hear the
cheers, the never-ending applause! I can
see the two
of us standing tall!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's when I'll point my finger at you and
say, "Applause for my
trainer, who made
me into a champion."
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Hehe. I stole that line from Papa.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: That's why I need you to stay healthy—for future me, and future you.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Because the two of us will become the
world's strongest duo.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: ...Think you can promise me that?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Bueno! A passionate promise! I'm glad I
brought you to this festival
today!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Now, why don't we start our infernal
festival training?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Not at all! The tacos, takoyaki, and
yakisoba from earlier were just to
prepare
us for the training yet to come!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
This festival's just gettin' started! While
we're here, we're gonna
conquer every last
one of these food stalls!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And so, with El by my side, I enjoy a rare
break at the summer festival.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
